findings.passage: This morning, the Secretary announced his support of strengthened photo ID requirements for absentee balloting. Voters casting their ballots in person must show photo ID, and we should consider applying that same standard to mail-in balloting.
findings.note: Remarks by the governor after the 2020 election, saying photo ID for in-person voting should be considered for mail ballots too.

findings.passage: There is nothing ‘Jim Crow’ about requiring a photo or state-issued ID to vote by absentee ballot – every Georgia voter must already do so when voting in-person.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name the day after he signed SB 202, defending the ID rule for absentee ballots.

findings.passage: I look forward to going three for three to ensure it’s easy to vote and hard to cheat in Georgia.
findings.note: Statement on the federal lawsuit against SB 202, the 2021 election law that includes the ID rule for absentee ballots.
He signed SB 202, the Election Integrity Act of 2021; his own statement of 2021-03-26 says he signed it the day before. The bill adds photo or state ID for absentee ballots.
